pair.title: Pair this transmitter
pair.description:
The panel ignores Home Assistant until you pair it. Your other remote stays paired. The panel accepts at most two remotes, and Home Assistant counts as one.

1. Switch the panel's power off at its light switch or breaker, then on again. The remote's power button does not work for this.
2. Wait until the panel is back on. That can take up to 30 seconds.
3. Tick the box below and select **Submit** straight away. The panel blinks.

data.confirm: The panel just came back on

unpair_all.title: Unpair all remotes
unpair_all.description:
This makes the panel forget **every** remote, Home Assistant included. Afterward, none of them works until you pair it again.

1. Switch the panel's power off at its light switch or breaker, then on again. The remote's power button does not work for this.
2. Wait until the panel is back on. That can take up to 30 seconds.
3. Tick the box below and select **Submit** straight away. The panel blinks.

Then pair your remote again with its own steps, and pair Home Assistant again with **Pair this transmitter**.

data.confirm: Remove every remote. The panel just came back on
